description: Erlang is a language built for many small tasks that send messages. It is used in reliable network systems. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Save each example as lesson.erl. Run erlc lesson.erl, then erl -noshell -s lesson main -s init stop. The file name must match the module name.
whatYouWillLearn: Group a few values with Erlang
Make a list by a rule with Erlang
learningObjectives: Call a local function with Erlang
